definitions.explanation: A portable space heater that burns kerosene (灯油) for fuel. Widely used in Japanese homes, especially in rural areas and older buildings without central heating.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}ストーブをつける。
examples.english: To turn on the kerosene heater.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{石油|せきゆ}ストーブが{活躍|かつやく}する。
examples.english: When winter comes, the kerosene heater gets a lot of use.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}ストーブの{上|うえ}にやかんを{置|お}いて{部屋|へや}を{加湿|かしつ}する。
examples.english: I put a kettle on the kerosene heater to humidify the room.

notes: Common collocations: {石油|せきゆ}ストーブをつける (to turn on), {石油|せきゆ}ストーブを{消|け}す (to turn off), {石油|せきゆ}ストーブに{灯油|とうゆ}を{入|い}れる (to add kerosene). Many Japanese place a kettle on top for humidity. Requires regular refueling with {灯油|とうゆ} (kerosene), which is sold at gas stations and delivered by truck in residential areas. Also called {灯油|とうゆ}ストーブ. Distinguished from {電気|でんき}ストーブ (electric heater) and エアコン (air conditioning/heating).
